title: Own Block
tagline: Transform properties into digital assets. Invest with regulatory compliance and blockchain security.
description:
Revolutionizing Real Estate Investment
Our platform combines blockchain technology with regulatory compliance to create a new paradigm for real estate ownership.
We are trying to solve the given mentioned arrears:
Compliant Tokenisation
ERC3643 compliant tokens ensuring regulatory requirements are met across jurisdictions.
Fractional Ownership
Invest in high-value properties with as little as 1% ownership through tokenization.
KYC Verification
Seamless identity verification ensuring all investors meet regulatory requirements.
how_its_made: We are trying to implement compliancy tokenisation, fractional ownership and KYC verification for making the process of buying / owning real estate simpler and secure for everyone. With next js, typescript for building majority of the things in the project , we also learnt about ERC 3643 omplementation.
